recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source edit is appropriate for FHIR-27908; future SupplyRequest changes should be handled in the current OO incubator/SupplyRequest ownership path rather than in inactive core source.
issue_request: FHIR-27908 is a Published/Persuasive R5 Orders and Observations change request asking that SupplyRequest.requester add CareTeam as an allowed requester target, because a team such as a nursing team can initiate a supply request.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-27908 was found. Git blame and pickaxe history show commit b1671782cb820cad536d9bcfb7747f99544cd085 added the CareTeam targetProfile to source/supplyrequest/structuredefinition-SupplyRequest.xml for SupplyRequest.requester on 2021-04-02, matching the accepted request.
additional_context: The current core build no longer includes SupplyRequest in source/fhir.ini [resources]; commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed supplyrequest and related OO resources while pointing current usage toward the OO incubator. The current OO incubator StructureDefinition-SupplyRequest JSON includes CareTeam in SupplyRequest.requester, so the active/current SupplyRequest artifact already reflects the FHIR-27908 semantics.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. Editing inactive core SupplyRequest source would not affect the current core build, and the current external SupplyRequest artifact already has the requested target type.
